{{nihongo|'''Kamisawa Shrine'''|神澤神社}} (also '''Kanzawa Shrine''', かんざわじんじゃ) is a [[shinto shrine]] in {{ill|Miyake, Tokyo|Q1154797|qid=Q1154797}} ({{ill|Miyake-jima|Q1075076|qid=Q1075076}}), in the [[Izu Province]] area of Tokyo Metropolis. Listed in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, it is located in the mountains of the northwestern part of Miyake-jima and is identified with Terano-Mikoto Shrine (てらのみことじんじゃ). The shrine's enshrined deity is Tematenjin (てまてんじん), also known as Tera-no-Mikoto, identified as the fourth child of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi|Q8009611|qid=Q8009611}} (Mishima Daimyōjin) and his consort Sataotamahime-no-Mikoto.

'''Kamisawa Shrine''' ('''Kanzawa Shrine''') (かんざわじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Miyake, Tokyo|Q1154797|qid=Q1154797}} ({{ill|Miyake-jima|Q1075076|qid=Q1075076}})<ref name="yao">[https://yaokami.jp/1131734/ 神澤神社] - 八百万の神</ref><ref name="engi-chosa">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140121-01.html 神沢神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref>.

It is located in the mountains of the Izu area in the northwestern part of Miyake-jima, near the west side of {{ill|Gosai-jinjna|Q131925937|qid=Q131925937}}<ref name="miyake">[https://www.soumu.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/14miyake/miyakehp/kankousasshi_0503.pdf 三宅島 (p.68, p.84)] - 東京都/三宅島観光協会</ref>.

It is identified with '''Terano-Mikoto Shrine''' (てらのみことじんじゃ), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}<ref name="yao"/><ref name="engi-chosa"/><ref name="miyake"/><ref name="jyr">[https://jun-yu-roku.com/shrine/engishiki/izu/ 伊豆國 九十二座] - 神社巡遊録</ref>.

== Enshrined deity ==
* Tematenjin (てまてんじん) / Tera-no-Mikoto (てらのみこと) - identified as "Tei," the fourth child among the eight princes born between {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi|Q8009611|qid=Q8009611}} (Mishima Daimyōjin) and his consort Sataotamahime-no-Mikoto (enshrined at {{ill|Oshaku Shrine|ja|御笏神社|qid=Q110915859}})<ref name="engi-chosa"/><ref name="miyake"/><ref>『{{ill|Miyakeki|Q17215100|qid=Q17215100}}』</ref>.
